basics.name: Noushin Omidvar
basics.label: Applied Machine Learning Scientist
basics.summary: Applied ML Scientist with expertise in AI for Science, cheminformatics, and computational chemistry. I design graph neural networks, generative optimization methods, and interpretable AI models to accelerate discovery in materials, catalysis, and energy storage.

work.name: Aionics Inc.
work.summary: Predictive modeling and multi-objective optimization for electrolyte and molecular formulation design.
highlights: Developed and deployed ML models to predict electrolyte and molecular formulation properties, boosting candidate screening speed by 40%.
Automated high-throughput data curation and feature engineering pipelines, reducing preprocessing time from days to hours.
Applied explainable AI methods (SHAP, diagnostics) to improve model interpretability and adoption across teams.
Standardized experiment tracking with Weights & Biases for reproducibility and workflow alignment.
Designed optimization workflows balancing conductivity, viscosity, and safety constraints in electrolyte formulations.
Prioritized experimental candidates via Pareto-front selection, cutting R&D iteration cycles by 60%.

work.name: Virginia Tech, Department of Chemical Engineering
work.summary: Ph.D. research in interpretable AI for catalysis and materials discovery.
highlights: Built ML pipelines integrating DFT-calculated properties with custom surface descriptors for large-scale materials screening.
Developed interpretable ML models to analyze chemical bonding and catalytic activity.
Applied statistical modeling to uncover physical-chemical drivers of catalyst performance.
Published 6+ peer-reviewed articles in top journals (Nature Communications, J. Phys. Chem. Letters, Trends in Chemistry).
Mentored graduate researchers on ML modeling and data analysis.
